versos.grego: Ὅθεν, ἀδελφοὶ ἅγιοι, κλήσεως ἐπουρανίου μέτοχοι, κατανοήσατε τὸν Ἀπόστολον καὶ Ἀρχιερέα τῆς ὁμολογίας ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦν,

controles.web: Therefore, holy brothers, partakers of a heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our confession, Jesus;
controles.kjv: Wherefore, holy brethren, partakers of the heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our profession, Christ Jesus;
controles.livre: Portanto, santos irmãos, participantes do chamado celestial, considerai o Apóstolo e Sumo Sacerdote da nossa declaração de fé, Jesus.

versos.grego: πιστὸν ὄντα τῷ ποιήσαντι αὐτὸν, ὡς καὶ Μωϋσῆς ἐν ὅλῳ τῷ οἴκῳ αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: who was faithful to him who appointed him, as also was Moses in all his house.
controles.kjv: Who was faithful to him that appointed him, as also Moses was faithful in all his house.
controles.livre: Ele é fiel àquele que o constituiu, assim como Moisés também foi em toda a casa de Deus.

versos.grego: πλείονος γὰρ οὗτος δόξης παρὰ Μωϋσῆν ἠξίωται καθ’ ὅσον πλείονα τιμὴν ἔχει τοῦ οἴκου ὁ κατασκευάσας αὐτόν.

controles.web: For he has been counted worthy of more glory than Moses, because he who built the house has more honor than the house.
controles.kjv: For this man was counted worthy of more glory than Moses, inasmuch as he who hath builded the house hath more honour than the house.
controles.livre: Pois ele é estimado como digno de maior glória do que Moisés, assim como mais honra do que a casa tem quem a construiu.

versos.grego: πᾶς γὰρ οἶκος κατασκευάζεται ὑπό τινος, ὁ δὲ πάντα κατασκευάσας Θεός.

controles.web: For every house is built by someone; but he who built all things is God.
controles.kjv: For every house is builded by some man; but he that built all things is God.
controles.livre: Porque toda casa é construída por alguém; mas aquele que construiu todas as coisas é Deus.

versos.grego: καὶ Μωϋσῆς μὲν πιστὸς ἐν ὅλῳ τῷ οἴκῳ αὐτοῦ ὡς θεράπων εἰς μαρτύριον τῶν λαληθησομένων,

controles.web: Moses indeed was faithful in all his house as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were afterward to be spoken,
controles.kjv: And Moses verily was faithful in all his house, as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were to be spoken after;
controles.livre: De fato, Moisés foi fiel como servo em toda a casa de Deus, para testemunho das coisas que haviam de ser ditas;

versos.grego: Χριστὸς δὲ ὡς υἱὸς ἐπὶ τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ· οὗ οἶκός ἐσμεν ἡμεῖς, ἐὰν τὴν παρρησίαν καὶ τὸ καύχημα τῆς ἐλπίδος μέχρι τέλους βεβαίαν κατάσχωμεν.

controles.web: but Christ is faithful as a Son over his house; whose house we are, if we hold fast our confidence and the glorying of our hope firm to the end.
controles.kjv: But Christ as a son over his own house; whose house are we, if we hold fast the confidence and the rejoicing of the hope firm unto the end.
controles.livre: mas Cristo é fiel como Filho sobre a sua casa. E nós somos sua casa, se até o fim mantivermos firmes a confiança e o orgulho da nossa esperança.

versos.grego: Διό, καθὼς λέγει τὸ Πνεῦμα τὸ Ἅγιον Σήμερον ἐὰν τῆς φωνῆς αὐτοῦ ἀκούσητε,

controles.web: Therefore, even as the Holy Spirit says,  “Today if you will hear his voice,
controles.kjv: Wherefore (as the Holy Ghost saith, To day if ye will hear his voice,
controles.livre: Portanto, como diz o Espírito Santo: Hoje, se ouvirdes a sua voz,

versos.grego: μὴ σκληρύνητε τὰς καρδίας ὑμῶν ὡς ἐν τῷ παραπικρασμῷ κατὰ τὴν ἡμέραν τοῦ πειρασμοῦ ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ,

controles.web: don’t harden your hearts, as in the rebellion, like as in the day of the trial in the wilderness,
controles.kjv: Harden not your hearts, as in the provocation, in the day of temptation in the wilderness:
controles.livre: não endureçais os vossos corações, como na provocação,  no dia da tentação no deserto;

versos.grego: οὗ ἐπείρασαν οἱ πατέρες ὑμῶν ἐν δοκιμασίᾳ καὶ εἶδον τὰ ἔργα μου

controles.web: where your fathers tested me by proving me, and saw my works for forty years.
controles.kjv: When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my works forty years.
controles.livre: onde os vossos pais  tentaram, provando, e viram as minhas obras por quarenta anos.

versos.grego: τεσσεράκοντα ἔτη. διὸ προσώχθισα τῇ γενεᾷ ταύτῃ καὶ εἶπον Ἀεὶ πλανῶνται τῇ καρδίᾳ· αὐτοὶ δὲ οὐκ ἔγνωσαν τὰς ὁδούς μου,

controles.web: Therefore I was displeased with that generation, and said, ‘They always err in their heart, but they didn’t know my ways;’
controles.kjv: Wherefore I was grieved with that generation, and said, They do alway err in their heart; and they have not known my ways.
controles.livre: Por isso me indignei contra essa geração, e disse: “Eles sempre se desviam nos corações, e não conheceram os meus caminhos”;

versos.grego: ὡς ὤμοσα ἐν τῇ ὀργῇ μου Εἰ εἰσελεύσονται εἰς τὴν κατάπαυσίν μου.

controles.web: as I swore in my wrath, ‘They will not enter into my rest.’”
controles.kjv: So I sware in my wrath, They shall not enter into my rest.)
controles.livre: Então jurei na minha ira: “Eles não entrarão no meu repouso”.

versos.grego: βλέπετε, ἀδελφοί, μή ποτε ἔσται ἔν τινι ὑμῶν καρδία πονηρὰ ἀπιστίας ἐν τῷ ἀποστῆναι ἀπὸ Θεοῦ ζῶντος,

controles.web: Beware, brothers, lest perhaps there be in any one of you an evil heart of unbelief, in falling away from the living God;
controles.kjv: Take heed, brethren, lest there be in any of you an evil heart of unbelief, in departing from the living God.
controles.livre: Cuidado, irmãos, para que nunca haja em algum de vós coração mau e infiel,  que se afaste do Deus vivo.

versos.grego: ἀλλὰ παρακαλεῖτε ἑαυτοὺς καθ’ ἑκάστην ἡμέραν, ἄχρις οὗ τὸ Σήμερον καλεῖται, ἵνα μὴ σκληρυνθῇ τις ἐξ ὑμῶν ἀπάτῃ τῆς ἁμαρτίας·

controles.web: but exhort one another day by day, so long as it is called “today”; lest any one of you be hardened by the deceitfulness of sin.
controles.kjv: But exhort one another daily, while it is called To day; lest any of you be hardened through the deceitfulness of sin.
controles.livre: Em vez disso, encorajai-vos uns aos outros a cada dia, durante o tempo chamado “hoje”; a fim de que nenhum de vós se endureça pelo engano do pecado.

versos.grego: μέτοχοι γὰρ τοῦ Χριστοῦ γεγόναμεν, ἐάνπερ τὴν ἀρχὴν τῆς ὑποστάσεως μέχρι τέλους βεβαίαν κατάσχωμεν.

controles.web: For we have become partakers of Christ, if we hold fast the beginning of our confidence firm to the end:
controles.kjv: For we are made partakers of Christ, if we hold the beginning of our confidence stedfast unto the end;
controles.livre: Pois nós temos nos tornado participantes de Cristo, se, de fato, mantivermos firme a confiança do princípio  até o fim;

versos.grego: ἐν τῷ λέγεσθαι Σήμερον ἐὰν τῆς φωνῆς αὐτοῦ ἀκούσητε, Μὴ σκληρύνητε τὰς καρδίας ὑμῶν ὡς ἐν τῷ παραπικρασμῷ.

controles.web: while it is said,  “Today if you will hear his voice, don’t harden your hearts, as in the rebellion.”
controles.kjv: While it is said, To day if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts, as in the provocation.
controles.livre: como é dito: Hoje, se ouvirdes a sua voz, não endureçais os vossos corações, como na provocação.

versos.grego: τίνες γὰρ ἀκούσαντες παρεπίκραναν; ἀλλ’ οὐ πάντες οἱ ἐξελθόντες ἐξ Αἰγύπτου διὰ Μωϋσέως;

controles.web: For who, when they heard, rebelled? No, didn’t all those who came out of Egypt by Moses?
controles.kjv: For some, when they had heard, did provoke: howbeit not all that came out of Egypt by Moses.
controles.livre: Pois quais foram os que, mesmo ouvindo, provocaram-no à ira ?  Não foram todos aqueles que saíram do Egito por meio de Moisés?

versos.grego: τίσιν δὲ προσώχθισεν τεσσεράκοντα ἔτη; οὐχὶ τοῖς ἁμαρτήσασιν, ὧν τὰ κῶλα ἔπεσεν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ;

controles.web: With whom was he displeased forty years? Wasn’t it with those who sinned, whose bodies fell in the wilderness?
controles.kjv: But with whom was he grieved forty years? was it not with them that had sinned, whose carcases fell in the wilderness?
controles.livre: E contra quais ele se indignou por quarenta anos? Não foi contra os que pecaram, cujos corpos caíram no deserto?

versos.grego: τίσιν δὲ ὤμοσεν μὴ εἰσελεύσεσθαι εἰς τὴν κατάπαυσιν αὐτοῦ εἰ μὴ τοῖς ἀπειθήσασιν;

controles.web: To whom did he swear that they wouldn’t enter into his rest, but to those who were disobedient?
controles.kjv: And to whom sware he that they should not enter into his rest, but to them that believed not?
controles.livre: E a quem ele jurou que não entrariam no seu repouso, senão aos que foram desobedientes?

versos.grego: καὶ βλέπομεν ὅτι οὐκ ἠδυνήθησαν εἰσελθεῖν δι’ ἀπιστίαν.

controles.web: We see that they were not able to enter in because of unbelief.
controles.kjv: So we see that they could not enter in because of unbelief.
controles.livre: Assim vemos que não puderam entrar por causa da incredulidade.
